text:
anya: Quick sync: following the RFC, we saw attribution mismatches when requests get proxied between regions and cache-hits hide the origin work. Need a small "handshake" field to carry budget metadata reliably through sampling and proxies.

devon: What's the minimal shape we need? One header on the envelope, or per-span? We want to avoid index bloat.

anya: Minimal: envelope header "origin_budget" (stringified decimal) + optional per-span "consumed" delta. Sampler invariant: the sampled root must carry origin_budget if present. No per-span mutation of origin_budget. Example: 

```
{"trace_id":"a1b2...",
 "origin_budget":"0.023",
 "spans":[{"id":"p1","svc":"proxy"},{"id":"m1","svc":"model","consumed":"0.022"}]
}
```

marcos: Two concerns: 1) storing origin_budget everywhere increases payloads/ingest cost, 2) merge semantics if middle proxies rewrite traces.

sue: For (2) force an origin-only write: only the first ingress (edge proxy/ingress) sets origin_budget. Any downstream service may write consumed deltas, but they never override origin_budget. If a proxy sees an origin_budget already present, it must not alter it.

katie: Cache behavior: fast-path cache-hits currently emit only tiny pings. We should ensure cache-fill events include consumed delta so fills get charged. Fast-path hits keep consumed=0. Fill: an async span later with consumed>0. That keeps common paths small.

devon: Sampler rules? We frequently sample only a tiny head. If consumed deltas are in non-sampled spans we'll lose signal.

anya: Proposed sampler invariant: when origin_budget exists, sampler must include the root envelope (with origin_budget) in the sampled output. Additionally, add a forced-sample predicate: if an incoming span reports consumed > X (configurable threshold) mark trace for sampling. That avoids missing heavy-cost requests.

marcos: Aggregator logic: reconcile as attribution = min(origin_budget, sum(consumed)). If no consumed deltas present (e.g., sampled head only), fall back to route-model estimate = origin_budget * model_estimate_fraction. We should store a per-route fallback tag with confidence.

katie: Example aggregator pseudo-SQL: 
```
SELECT route, trace_id,
  min(origin_budget) AS origin_budget,
  sum(consumed) AS total_consumed,
  least(min(origin_budget), sum(consumed)) AS reconciled_cost
FROM traces
GROUP BY route, trace_id;
```

sue: Rollout plan: opt-in ingest flag per-region/tenant. Default off. Phase 0: collectors accept origin_budget but ignore for billing. Phase 1: enable attribution in staging region and validate. Phase 2: gradual prod enable for small tenant cohort. Add backfill job to reconcile historical route-models for enabled tenants.

devon: Compliance check: numeric only, no PII. Approve from security but we should doc retention impact and mask in exports.

marcos: Tests to add: missing origin_budget, duplicate origin_budget (two ingress points), cache-fill vs fast-hit, sampler-dropping-deltas, forced-sample threshold behavior. I'll open infra issues and add unit/integration stubs.

anya: I'll write a 1-pager addendum for the RFC: envelope schema, sampler invariant, aggregator query, rollout stages and test matrix. Will link PR for sampler change.

obs-bot: Tracker created: OBS-901 (tests + RFC addendum).

anya: Thanks all, will ping once addendum + PR ready.
